ios.desc:
Islamvy: Your AI-Powered Islamic Companion

Strengthen your connection with faith every single day with Islamvy, the world's most advanced AI-powered Islamic lifestyle app. Designed for the modern Muslim, Islamvy blends sacred traditions with cutting-edge technology to guide your spiritual journey.

Whether you need precise prayer times, AI-generated dhikr plans, deep Islamic dream interpretation, or a supportive global community—Islamvy brings everything together in one seamless experience.

AI-POWERED FEATURES:

AI Personalized Dhikr and Dua: Receive a fully customized daily dhikr program based on your name, birth data, and spiritual intention.

AI Islamic Dream Interpretation: Share your dreams and receive deep, personalized analysis grounded in traditional Islamic scholarship.

AI Daily Verse and Hadith: Receive a contextually relevant Quran verse or Hadith every morning, selected by AI.

ESSENTIAL ISLAMIC TOOLS:

Accurate Prayer Times: Location-based timings with beautiful Adhan notifications.

Holy Quran: Full Quran with Arabic text, translations, and audio recitations.

Qibla Compass and Mosque Finder: Find the exact Qibla direction and discover nearby mosques instantly.

Collective Hatim System: Join group Quran completions with automated juz management.

Spiritual Community: Share duas and dhikrs with believers worldwide.

Live Kaaba: Watch high-quality 24/7 live broadcasts from Makkah.

Zakat Calculator: Easily calculate your zakat with live metal price tracking.

Islamic Shop: Discover handpicked Islamic lifestyle products.

Islamvy is built for Muslims who want to deepen their connection with Allah while honoring Islamic tradition through modern innovation.

Download Islamvy today and transform your spiritual practice!
